# Environment variables

Primus-Turbo reads the runtime variables below through `primus_turbo.common.envs`.

- Each value is parsed the first time it is read, and that value is kept for the rest of the process. Set variables before the first use of Primus-Turbo; setting one later has no effect.
- Code that must change a variable at run time calls `envs.set_env(name, value)`, which also drops the cached value.
- Variables read by the C++ extension are cached by C++ at its own first read, so `set_env()` reaches C++ only before that.
- To see the value Primus-Turbo uses, read `primus_turbo.common.envs.<NAME>`.

Variables owned by other projects (FlyDSL, Triton, NVSHMEM, the launcher's `RANK` / `WORLD_SIZE`, and the Primus `FLUX_*` / `PRIMUS_MXFP4_*` recipe flags) are not listed here.

## Runtime variables

### Logging

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_LOG_LEVEL` | `str` | `WARNING` | Level of the `primus_turbo` logger: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR or CRITICAL (any case). An unknown name falls back to WARNING. Read once, when the logger singleton is created. |

### Backend selection

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_GEMM_BACKEND` | `str \| None` | unset | GEMM backend, e.g. HIPBLASLT, AITER. Either one backend for every precision or a per-precision list: "FP4:HIPBLASLT,FP8:AITER", with "other:&lt;backend&gt;" for the rest. Any slot also accepts "autotune" to auto-tune that precision only, e.g. "FP8:autotune,other:HIPBLASLT". Unset (or blank) leaves the choice to the dispatcher. Read at the first dispatch that has no code-level setting (`GlobalBackendManager.set_gemm_backend`); the five backend variables and PRIMUS_TURBO_AUTO_TUNE are read again after `GlobalBackendManager.reset()`. |
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_GROUPED_GEMM_BACKEND` | `str \| None` | unset | Grouped GEMM backend. Same format as PRIMUS_TURBO_GEMM_BACKEND. |
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_ATTN_BACKEND` | `str \| None` | unset | Flash-attention backend (dense and varlen share it). Same per-precision format as PRIMUS_TURBO_GEMM_BACKEND. Unset auto-selects: FLYDSL when eligible, else the op's fallback. GLUON is explicit and forward-only, never auto-selected; it is dense-only, so selecting it makes varlen dispatch fail before launch. Flash and sparse attention keep separate keys because their backend sets differ (only flash has AITER, only sparse has TRITON). |
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_SPARSE_ATTN_BACKEND` | `str \| None` | unset | Sparse-attention (DeepSeek-V4 sparse-MLA) backend, e.g. FLYDSL, TRITON, or "autotune". |
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_MLA_BWD_IMPL` | `str` | `flydsl` | Kernels of the gfx1250 DeepSeek-V3 MLA attention backward (qk 192 / v 128) under the FLYDSL backend: "flydsl" (unset or blank) or "hk", the HipKittens kernels, which hand a call they cannot take to FlyDSL (e.g. seqlen_q % 384 not 0 or 256, see their README). Read at the first MLA backward (attention_flydsl_gfx1250_mla_impl.mla_bwd_impl); another value raises ValueError. |
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_MLA_BWD_DS_SCRATCH_MB` | `int` | `5120` | Most dS scratch, in MiB, the FlyDSL gfx1250 MLA backward holds at once (5120 when unset). The backward stores dS between its dK / dV and dQ kernels, about batch * heads * seqlen_q * seqlen_kv bytes in all (4.33 GB at b2 s4096 h128): all heads on one scratch when that is within this, else the heads in chunks, two in flight, that are (gfx1250_mla.bwd.ds_chunkings; a few percent slower); below two heads' scratch (0 included) it runs one head at a time, on that one head's scratch even when it is over this (about batch * seqlen_q * seqlen_kv bytes: 16 GiB at seqlen 131072; a device without that much free memory raises torch.OutOfMemoryError). Read at every MLA backward (through the cache); a value that is not a non-negative integer raises ValueError. |
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_MOE_DISPATCH_COMBINE_BACKEND` | `str \| None` | unset | MoE dispatch/combine EP backend: TURBO (the default when unset), DEEP_EP, or a custom EP name such as UCCL_EP. "autotune" is rejected with an AssertionError. |

### Auto-tune

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_AUTO_TUNE` | `bool` | `False` | "1" turns auto-tuning across registered kernel backends on for every op, and the FlyDSL kernel-level tuners with it. An explicit per-op backend still wins over it, and so does `GlobalBackendManager.set_auto_tune`. Read at the first dispatch or FlyDSL launch. |

### Dispatch diagnostics

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_DISPATCH_REPORT` | `str \| None` | unset | A file path: record which backend every dispatcher picked for every input shape, and why (user, autotune, default or fallback), log each new choice at INFO, and write the report there as JSON when the process exits. "{rank}" in the path is replaced by $RANK (0 when unset) and "{pid}" by the process id. Unset keeps only the per-dispatcher totals of `dispatch_report()`. |
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_STRICT_DISPATCH` | `bool` | `False` | "1" makes a fallback an error: when the default backend cannot handle the inputs, dispatch raises RuntimeError instead of warning and running another registered backend. |

### Kernel behavior

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_ATTN_V3_ATOMIC_FP32` | `bool` | `True` | Whether the attention V3 (CK) backward accumulates with FP32 atomics. Only "0" disables it; unset, "1" and any other value keep it on. Read at the first forward that does not pass `is_v3_atomic_fp32` explicitly. |
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_WGRAD_ACCUM_OVERWRITE_OUT` | `bool` | `False` | "1" lets the FP4 variable-K grouped GEMM (wgrad) overwrite `out` with beta=0 instead of accumulating into it, when the caller allows it and no CUDA graph is being captured. |
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_GROUPED_GEMM_EXACT_KEYS` | `bool` | `False` | "1" makes the gfx1250 FlyDSL bf16 grouped GEMM apply its tuned keys (the per-shape tables and the whole-argument sets) only at the exact avg_m (rows // experts) they were measured at, for A/B runs against the default, where a call whose avg_m is within a factor sqrt(2) of a key takes the nearest key on a log scale. Read at every call that can take a key. |

### Expert parallel

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_EP_FORCE_CURRENT_STREAM` | `bool` | `False` | A non-zero integer runs the EP dispatch/combine kernels on the caller's current stream instead of the Buffer's comm stream. Parsed as C++ does (`is_ep_force_current_stream` in deep_ep/configs.h, which caches it once per process): unset is off, and an empty or non-integer value is an error (ValueError here, std::stoi throws in C++). On gfx1250 the intranode runtime reads it when it is constructed. `DeepEPTokenDispatcher` writes "1" with `set_env()` when a dispatcher asks for `deepep_use_comm_stream=False`. |
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_JAX_DEEPEP_MODE` | `str \| None` | unset | JAX DeepEP launch mode: "inproc" (the default when unset) or "per_process"; case and "-"/"_" are normalized by `LaunchMode.from_str`. `auto_detect_mode` and `setup(mode=...)` write it with `set_env()`, `reset_runtime()` clears it, and the mode locks at the first DeepEP call. |

### Mega MoE (FlyDSL FP8 combine)

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PT_MEGA_FP8_COMBINE_AUTOTUNE` | `bool` | `True` | Online tuning of the FP8 combine's CU split. On unless set to "0", "false" or "False". Read once, when `primus_turbo.flydsl.mega.fp8.combine_autotune` is imported. |
| `PT_MEGA_FP8_COMBINE_AUTOTUNE_VERBOSE` | `bool` | `True` | One log line per shape when the tuned CU split locks in. Same values and timing as above. |
| `PT_MEGA_FP8_COMBINE_CU_CANDIDATES` | `tuple[int, ...]` | `16, 32, 48, 64, 80, 96, 128` | Candidate CU splits the combine tuner tries, comma- or space-separated positive integers. Read once, at import of combine_autotune. A bad value raises ValueError there. 0 is not "off" for a CU split: the combine reads it as "no PUSH role", and with the reduce on, as in every production call, the reduce would then wait forever for arrivals nobody sends. |
| `PT_MEGA_FP8_COMBINE_TUNE_REPS` | `int` | `3` | Timed samples per candidate CU split. Read once, at import of combine_autotune. Must be positive: an empty schedule would lock in at the first call, on a candidate never measured. |
| `PT_MEGA_FP8_L1_COMBINE_CU`<br>`PT_MEGA_FP8_L2_COMBINE_CU` | `int \| None` | unset | Pin the stage-1 (L1) / stage-2 (L2) combine CU split and skip tuning for it. A positive block count; unset leaves it to the tuner. Read once, at import of the fused_mega_moe stage-1 / stage-2 FP8 impl modules. |

### JAX grouped GEMM (hipBLASLt / FlyDSL)

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_CACHE` | `str` | `~/.cache/primus_turbo` | Directory for the FlyDSL FFI trampoline library (libflydsl_launch.so), built with hipcc on first use. Read when the trampoline is first built. |
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_HB_GG_TUNE` | `str` | `subprocess` | How the hipBLASLt grouped GEMM picks its kernel at trace time: "subprocess" (the default; time the candidates in a child process on the same GPU), "inproc", or "0" to keep hipBLASLt's heuristic choice. |
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_HB_GG_TUNE_CANDIDATES` | `int` | `256` | Maximum number of hipBLASLt grouped GEMM candidates the tuner times. |
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_HB_GG_TUNE_CACHE` | `str` | `~/.cache/primus_turbo/hipblaslt_grouped_gemm_tune.json` | On-disk cache of tuned hipBLASLt grouped GEMM algorithms (JSON). |
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_HB_GG_DEBUG` | `bool` | `False` | Any non-empty value prints the tuner's results and its subprocess's stderr. |
| `PRIMUS_FLYDSL_ROWS_CAP_DIV` | `int` | `0` | d &gt; 1: with ring-of-experts EP, launch the FlyDSL grouped GEMM with a tile grid for M/d rows when sum(group_lens) &lt;= M/d, and the full grid otherwise. 0 (the default) always uses the full grid. Read once, at import of grouped_gemm_flydsl. |
| `PRIMUS_FLYDSL_ZERO_PAD` | `bool` | `True` | Whether the FlyDSL grouped GEMM zeroes output rows past sum(group_lens) when the caller does not say. Only "0" turns it off. |
| `PRIMUS_FLYDSL_ALLOW_NOZERO` | `bool` | `False` | "1" honours zero_pad=False in grouped_gemm_flydsl (valid only when sum(group_lens) == M); otherwise the output is always zero-padded. |
| `PRIMUS_FLYDSL_WG_MAX_G` | `int` | `64` | Largest group count the FlyDSL variable-K (wgrad) kernel is used for. It ranks groups with one 64-lane wave, so 64 is the correct value; larger values are for sensitivity tests only. Read once, at import of grouped_gemm_flydsl. |
| `PRIMUS_FLYDSL_NN`<br>`PRIMUS_FLYDSL_NT`<br>`PRIMUS_FLYDSL_WG` | `str` | `` | FlyDSL grouped GEMM tile overrides for the forward (NN), input-gradient (NT) and weight-gradient (WG) kernels, e.g. "BM=128,GROUP_M=2"; they apply to every shape. |
| `PRIMUS_FP8_BWD` | `str` | `all` | Backward of the FlyDSL FP8 grouped GEMM: "all" (FP8 dA and dW, the default), "dgrad" (FP8 dA, bf16 dW) or "bf16" (bf16 for both). Read once, at import of grouped_gemm_flydsl_fp8. |

### Read by the C++ extension

These getters mirror the C++ parsing so Python can report the effective value; C++ reads the variable itself and caches it once per process.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_DEEPEP_CPU_TIMEOUT` | `int` | `300` | DeepEP host-side timeout in seconds (deep_ep/configs.h). Unset, empty or a non-integer reads as 300. |
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_DEEPEP_DISABLE_CHEAP_FENCE` | `bool` | `False` | A non-zero integer makes the intranode dispatch/combine channels publish their tails with a full system-scope release/acquire instead of the cheap per-warp fence (gfx1250 always does). C++ caches it separately in the dispatch and combine launchers, each at its first call. |
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_DEEPEP_V2_TDM_GUARD` | `str` | `off` | The guards of DeepEP V2 (MI455X) for TDM operations lost while KFD evicts a queue. "off" (default): neither guard; "redo": move a row again when one pass takes more than 0.5 ms; "all": also compare 32 words of every TDM load with its source and reload stale data. |

ODC (on-demand-comm) rocSHMEM GDA device-kernel knobs, consumed by csrc/kernels/odc_rocshmem/odc_rocshmem_gda.cu for the multi-node reduce-scatter / all-gather device kernels.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_ODC_GDA_BLOCK` | `int` | `256` | Threads per block of the ODC GDA device kernels, clamped to [32, 1024]. |
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_ODC_GDA_PIPE` | `int` | `1` | Reduce-scatter peer-pipeline batch depth (1 = serial), clamped to [1, 64]. |
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_ODC_GDA_NUM_QP` | `int` | `1` | rocSHMEM QPs/contexts for multi-QP NIC concurrency, clamped to [1, 256]; above 1 selects the multi-QP path. |

JAX hipBLASLt grouped GEMM (csrc/jax/grouped_gemm/hipblaslt_grouped_gemm.cpp).

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_HB_GG_TUNE_MAX_ROWS` | `int` | `131072` | Rows of the tuning problem; larger M share one tuned entry. Python's tuner reads it too. |
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_HB_GG_HOST_ROWS` | `str \| None` | unset | "max" sizes the launch for M rows per group instead of ceil(M/G) plus one macro tile. |
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_HB_GG_PICK_NN`<br>`PRIMUS_TURBO_HB_GG_PICK_NT`<br>`PRIMUS_TURBO_HB_GG_PICK_TN` | `int` | `0` | k: use the k-th supported heuristic candidate for the forward (NN), input-gradient (NT) or weight-gradient (TN) product instead of the first (kernel sweeps). C++ reads it at every call. |
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_HB_GG_VERBOSE` | `bool` | `False` | Set (to any value): log the plans and tuning of the hipBLASLt grouped GEMM. |

### Flux

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_DGATE_ACC_ATOMIC` | `bool` | `True` | "0" makes the Flux dgate epilogue accumulate without atomics. Unset and any other value keep the atomic path. Read once, when the MXFP4 quant kernel module is imported. |

## Build-time variables

Read by `setup.py` and `tools/` when the extension is built, not at run time.

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_FRAMEWORK` | `PYTORCH` | Frameworks to build the extension for, `;`-separated: `PYTORCH`, `JAX`, or `PYTORCH;JAX`. |
| `GPU_ARCHS` | the GPU of the build machine | Target architectures, `;`-separated, e.g. `gfx942;gfx950`. `native` means the build machine's GPU. Supported: `gfx942`, `gfx950`, `gfx1250`. |
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_BUILD_CK` | on | Build the CK (ck_tile) GEMM backend. `0`, `false`, `off` or empty disable it. Always off on gfx1250. |
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_BUILD_HK_MLA` | on | On a gfx1250 build, build the HipKittens MLA backward code objects. `0`, `false`, `off` or empty skip them, and the MLA backward stays on FlyDSL. |
| `PRIMUS_TURBO_HK_CXX` | `amdclang++` from `PATH`, `ROCM_PATH`, `ROCM_HOME` or `/opt/rocm` | Compiler for the HipKittens gfx1250 MLA code objects. |
| `MAX_JOBS` | ninja's worker count; 64 jobs per HIP compile | Number of ninja workers, and of parallel jobs within each HIP compile (`-parallel-jobs`). |
| `CXX` | `hipcc` under the ROCm home | Compiler for the extension; also the default for `CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER` and `CMAKE_HIP_COMPILER`. |
